decision.reason: [ev-8ceba924ad20] and [ev-632a3911583a] state the subject and the change. In Loki 3.0.0, shared_store_key_prefix was removed from the shipper configuration, so anyone who set the boltdb-shipper or tsdb key prefix to something other than `index/` must set `path_prefix` on their existing period configs to that old value. Neither excerpt says what happens if an operator skips this. They do not say whether Loki fails to start or rejects the config, quietly uses `index/`, or can no longer find or query existing index data. The open consequence aspect therefore needs a source that describes the effect of skipping this step.
